item.title: Meta bets open, on-device model can win AI power struggle
item.summary: Meta Platforms is trying to turn open-source AI into a strategic weapon rather than a side project. On August 10, the company released Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open-weights model built for local, agentic tasks, alongside a 6,500-word essay from CEO Mark Zuckerberg arguing that distributing powerful AI widely — not concentrating it inside a handful of labs — is the surest way to avoid outcomes like mass unemployment or an unchecked "singular" superintelligence. The pairing signals that Meta now sees openness itself as the differentiator it needs while it plays catch-up to Anthropic and OpenAI.
